 Who is Taryn Manning? GTA 6 Vicki actor and singer

 Get to know the GTA 6 actor.

 With the cast of GTA 6 now out in the open, you may be wondering who is Taryn Manning?
 Ad She plays Vicki, one of the game's vast cast of supporting characters, and someone you'll meet several times during the game's story.
 So, if you're curious about the name behind the voice, here's what you need to know about Vicki's actor Taryn Manning.
 Who is Taryn Manning? 
 Taryn Manning.  Photo by Gregg DeGuire/Variety via Getty Images Age: 48
 Job: Actor, singer, producer and director
 Instagram: @ tarynmanning 
 Born in Virginia and raised in Arizona and later California, Manning began her acting career with a series of minor TV roles in episodes of The Practice, Get Real, NYPD Blue and Popular, as well as films like 8 Mile and Cold Mountain.
 Her breakout came in the 2005 Craig Brewer film Hustle & Flow, where she played Memphis prostitute Nola, leading to further roles in films such as Weirdsville, After Sex, Jack and Jill vs the World and TV shows like Sons of Anarchy.

 Accept and continue Since 2013, she has become best-known for her role as Tiffany 'Pennsatucky' Doggett in Orange is the New Black.
 Outside of acting, she has had a successful music career both as a solo artist and as part of the band Boomkat with her brother Kellin, with whom she owns the independent record label Little Vanilla Records. She has also appeared in various music videos for artists like Nickelback, will.i.am, Train, Passion Pit and more.
 Like many of the cast of GTA 6, including both Jason and Cal 's actors, Vicki represents Manning's first role in video game voice acting.
